Departments = the school each page names (stated, not inferred). Degree suffixes stripped from names per iron rules. Excluded: system-wide administrators listed on the cuaa.edu/about/administration.html page (deans of Arts & Sciences, Business, Education, Health Professions, Nursing — administrators over both CUW/CUAA campuses, not Ann Arbor teaching faculty on these rosters); two orphan faculty image files on the Health Professions page (kbrennan.jpg, lgarrett.jpg) with no matching name entries — not included since no names were given (never invent). PARTIAL: the School of Arts & Sciences and the Haab School of Business have no public faculty pages on cuaa.edu (their index pages redirect to a generic schools overview), and the shared CUW catalog (catalog.cuw.edu) merges CUW Mequon and CUAA faculty without reliable campus attribution, so Ann Arbor-only faculty for those two schools could not be honestly extracted.
